name: Ahool
description: The Ahool is a reported giant bat- or flying-primate-like cryptid said to inhabit the rainforests and river valleys of western Java. It is best known from accounts gathered by the Dutch naturalist Ernest Bartels in the 1920s and popularised in English-language cryptozoology by Ivan T. Sanderson.
origin: Reports are concentrated in the rainforests, river valleys, and volcanic uplands of western Java, particularly the Salak and Halimun mountain regions.
